question: Should OpenClaw accept a maintained curated OpenRouter `/images` model list now, and if so should this PR be rebased as the catalog/transport portion of the related stable-model migration work?
rationale: The code can be made mechanically compatible with current main, but choosing a curated provider catalog and coordinating it with default/migration policy is a lasting provider-product decision.

options.title: Sponsor a current-main port
options.body: Rebase this narrow `/images` transport and curated-model work onto the current capability contract, while preserving existing configured legacy refs and coordinating the stable-default changes separately.

options.title: Defer to one catalog policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers decide whether OpenRouter image models should remain curated or move to a broader provider-catalog design tracked by the canonical feature request.

options.title: Limit the scope to migrations
options.body: Land only stable-default and doctor-migration work first, then reopen a separate reviewed proposal for additional `/images` models.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a current-main port
recommendation.body: Rebase this narrow `/images` transport and curated-model work onto the current capability contract, while preserving existing configured legacy refs and coordinating the stable-default changes separately.

likelyOwner.reason: Their active related proposal is the closest current work on OpenRouter image defaults, legacy refs, and migration behavior.
